# Entertainment Weekly

> > Entertainment Weekly is a leading entertainment news and pop culture publication covering film, television, awards, and celebrity news.

Entertainment Weekly provides breaking entertainment news, in-depth features, cast retrospectives, TV recaps, awards season coverage including the Oscars, and celebrity interviews. The site covers major entertainment franchises, reality TV competitions like Survivor and SNL, and trending pop culture moments.

## Key Topics

- Oscars and Awards Season
- Timothée Chalamet
- Cast Then-and-Now Features
- Harry Potter Franchise
- Behind-the-Scenes Stories
- Celebrity Feuds and Controversies
- Netflix Original Content
- Saturday Night Live (SNL)
- Survivor Reality Competition
- Fargo and Coen Brothers
- The View Talk Show
- Film and TV Recaps
- Entertainment Industry News
- Awards Predictions and Secret Ballots
- Performing Arts and Theater
